## Why

Describe the player problem or technical defect and why it matters.

## Behavior

Describe the resulting behavior and any state/rules contract changes.

## Verification

List meaningful checks actually performed and their results.

## Issues and session

Use a separate `Closes #N` line for each resolved issue. Include the real
originating-session link when available.

## Filed

If new issues were necessary, link them and state the reason allowed by AGENTS.md.

## Questions

List any owner decision still needed and the recommended choice.
